cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, course rules Goliad.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Goliad.

cards.detail: The binder also places a CH 12 switch in the "Thence" sequence. This guide models one CH 12 contact; check the exact transfer timing with an instructor.
